title: Romania Economic Indicators — eCifre
description:
A structured and versioned collection of economic indicators for Romania, compiled and normalized by eCifre from official Romanian and European public data sources.

The dataset provides historical time series covering areas such as economic growth, inflation, wages, employment, exchange rates, public finance, demographics, construction, energy and regional (county-level) economic indicators for Romania.

Interactive visualizations, current values, indicator methodology and economic context are available at https://ecifre.ro.

This Zenodo record represents a versioned snapshot of the public eCifre economic dataset. eCifre's own data pipeline remains the live, continuously-updated source — not Zenodo.

The original institutions listed in DATA_SOURCES.md remain the authoritative sources for the underlying statistics; eCifre collects, normalizes and republishes what they publish, without re-deriving or re-estimating published figures.
notes: Generated from eCifre's public data pipeline (scripts/build_canonical_dataset.py in the source repository). See CHANGELOG.md in this upload for what changed in this specific version.
